_doc: How each Lambda environment variable relates to your local .env. Used by lambda-env.js. A release NEVER changes a variable that already exists on the Lambda (use --overwrite NAME for that). This file only decides where the value of a NEW variable comes from, and which differences between local and Lambda are expected.

_policies.copy-local: new variable: take the value from the local .env (same value on both sides). Drift between local and Lambda is reported.
_policies.literal: new variable: use "value" from this file (non-secret constants only).
_policies.ask: environment-specific (differs between local and Lambda): never copied from .env. The value must be put in scripts/aws/.env.lambda (git-ignored); until then a release that needs it is blocked. Differences are expected and not reported.

API_BASE_URL.note: the deployed API Gateway URL (differs from local)

APPLE_PAY_SYED_CERT_SECRET_NAME.note: AWS Secrets Manager name, Lambda only

APPLE_PAY_SYED_KEY_SECRET_NAME.note: AWS Secrets Manager name, Lambda only

DOMAIN_NAME.note: Apple Pay domain, differs between local and Lambda

ENV.note: DEV locally vs the Lambda's value — must stay different
